name: Amazon SES
description: Production email delivery dependency used by worker Lambdas to send order-related emails. SES identities are not created by Terraform in this repo, so the sender identity must be verified outside this stack in the active AWS region.

sender.description: Verified sender address used as the SES Source and Reply-To address.

producers.name: customerConfirmation
producers.description: Sends paid-order confirmation emails to customers.

producers.name: ownerNotification
producers.description: Sends paid-order notification emails to the store owner.

producers.name: shipmentNotification
producers.description: Sends shipment notification emails to customers after an order is marked shipped.

email_flows.name: Customer order confirmation
email_flows.recipient: Customer email from the paid order, or CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION_EMAIL when a sandbox/test override is configured.
email_flows.description: Confirms that payment was recorded for the order and stores delivery markers on the order record.

email_flows.name: Owner order notification
email_flows.description: Notifies the store owner that a paid order entered the fulfillment pipeline and stores delivery markers on the order record.

email_flows.name: Customer shipment notification
email_flows.recipient: Customer email from the order, or CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION_EMAIL when a sandbox/test override is configured.
email_flows.description: Sends tracking/shipment details after fulfillment and stores delivery markers on the order record.
